seg.seg_note: Four segments: Life Sciences, Diagnostics, Dental, Environmental & Applied Solutions (+ Other = unallocated corporate). Releases in this period carry no segment table; segment sales/OP from the 10-Q segment note and depreciation, amortization and growth from the 10-Q MD&A segment sections (three-month columns). Total/segment growth tables in this period are presented as components that sum to total growth (core + acquisitions + currency = total); acq and fx are stored with the sign flipped to the 'less the impact of' convention used from Q3-17 onward (core = total + acq + fx). Release labels: 'Core (non-GAAP)' 2.5, 'Acquisitions (non-GAAP)' 6.0, 'Impact of currency translation (non-GAAP)' (1.5); 10-Q MD&A: 'Existing businesses', 'Acquisitions and other', 'Currency exchange rates'. Dental growth table all '—' (0.0). A product line was transferred from Life Sciences to Environmental & Applied Solutions in Q1-17 (growth effect in 'Acquisitions and other'). Recurring revenue % not disclosed (pre-ASC 606).

ngaap.guidance: Q2-17: GAAP diluted EPS (cont. ops) $0.77-$0.80; adjusted diluted EPS $0.95-$0.98 (pretax amortization $0.23 / $166.0m pretax, $132.0m after-tax; tax effect ($0.05)). FY2017: GAAP diluted EPS $3.13-$3.23; adjusted diluted EPS maintained at $3.85-$3.95 (pretax amortization $0.94 / $664.0m pretax, $527.9m after-tax; tax effect ($0.19); Q1 discrete tax ($0.03)); ~$40m of equity-comp excess tax benefits anticipated for the rest of 2017. 10-Q: if 31-Mar-2017 FX rates prevail, currency would reduce FY2017 sales by ~1.5%.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS from continuing ops (non-GAAP) adds back pretax amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (tax-effected in the aggregate 'Tax effect' line) plus gains/charges deemed non-recurring (sale of investments, restructuring plans fundamentally different from ongoing DBS productivity, acquisition-related items, early extinguishment of debt) and discrete tax items. From 2017 (ASU 2016-09) equity-compensation excess tax benefits above ~$10m/quarter anticipated are excluded. No adjusted operating profit or margin is published. Item after-tax amounts are from the release footnotes. Q1-17 is the first quarter under ASU 2016-09; $16m of the $26m realized excess tax benefit excluded. No free cash flow table in the release.
